name: OpenBuilder

soc2_evidence.signal: Security page exists at theopenbuilder.com/security (now 404) but cached content confirms AWS-hosted infrastructure with VPC, SSL/TLS, encrypted data at rest/transit, annual pen testing. No SOC 2 certification mentioned.
Hosts on AWS (RDS, S3) in the US. No SOC 2 attestation found on website or trust center.

hiring_signals: Founding DevOps Engineer (SF, $170K-$220K, 1-2% equity) — direct infra/DevOps signal
aws_evidence: Security documentation explicitly states OpenBuilder hosts all software in AWS (US), uses AWS-managed PostgreSQL RDS and S3, and operates within its own VPC.
pitch_note: AWS-native (RDS + S3 confirmed), seed funded, hiring a Founding DevOps Engineer now — classic pre-SOC 2 profile. No-code SaaS for B2B means enterprise customers will demand a trust report soon. Pitch around: 'Your DevOps hire will need to own the compliance stack — let us give them a head start with SOC 2 Type I in weeks, not months.'

name: Prox

soc2_evidence.signal: Homepage explicitly states 'SOC 2 Type II certified' with trust center at trust.useprox.com. Independent audit attests to access, change-management, and incident-response controls.

hiring_signals: Hiring Founding Engineer (SF, $200K + 1% equity) — infra-heavy role involving Docker, AWS, telephony systems
aws_evidence: Founding Engineer job description references Docker and AWS in real system design interviews; company is SF-based, AWS likely but not confirmed as exclusive cloud.
pitch_note: Already SOC 2 Type II certified — disqualified as a new buyer. Could be relevant only if they need ongoing audit support or scope expansion, but not a primary prospect.

name: Fernstone

soc2_evidence.signal: AI-native insurance brokerage operating in regulated fintech/insurance sector with 100+ business clients. No SOC 2 page, trust center, or compliance mention found on fernstone.com.
Raised $1.5M pre-seed + YC funding. Insurance carriers and enterprise buyers typically require SOC 2 for data-sharing relationships.

hiring_signals: Growth & Operations Lead posting — no security/DevOps/GRC roles listed
Not actively hiring on YC platform for technical/infra roles
aws_evidence: No cloud infrastructure information publicly available for Fernstone.
pitch_note: Insurance/fintech = heavy regulated buyer pressure (carriers, MGAs, reinsurers all demand SOC 2). 2-person team with $2.8M raised, 100+ business clients, no compliance certifications found — exactly the inflection point where enterprise sales stalls without a trust report. Pitch: 'Your insurance carrier partners and corporate clients will ask for SOC 2 before expanding the relationship — we can get you Type I in 8 weeks.'

name: Brickanta

soc2_evidence.signal: Trust center at trust.brickanta.com shows ISO 27001 (certified), GDPR (compliant), EU AI Act (compliant) — no SOC 2 listed. US enterprise construction buyers often require SOC 2.
ISO 27001:2022 certified (Certificate SE559537-3647) confirms security maturity but SOC 2 not pursued, likely due to EU-primary focus (Stockholm HQ).

hiring_signals: GTM Engineer role open — focused on revenue/product bridge, no security/infra roles
Software / AI Engineering role open — general engineering, no DevOps/GRC signal
aws_evidence: No cloud provider specified publicly. Stockholm HQ and EU AI Act compliance suggest possible European cloud (AWS EU or Azure). Cannot confirm AWS-native.
pitch_note: Already ISO 27001 certified and Stockholm-based — primary compliance story is EU-aligned (GDPR, EU AI Act). SOC 2 is a US-market requirement; Brickanta may not feel urgency unless expanding to North American enterprise construction firms. Lower priority unless they signal US go-to-market push. Score penalized for EU-only compliance posture and unknown AWS footprint.

name: Uplane

soc2_evidence.signal: Website states ISO 27001 compliant and GDPR compliant. No SOC 2 mentioned. Enterprise-grade security claim with no attestation found.
19-person team, $5M raised, selling to B2B marketing buyers including regulated industries (finance, healthcare mentioned as target verticals).

hiring_signals: Forward Deployed Engineer (Berlin) — product/client integration role
No security, GRC, DevOps, or infra-specific roles listed on YC or job board
aws_evidence: No cloud provider publicly disclosed. Dual HQ in Berlin and SF with EU-leaning compliance (ISO 27001, GDPR) suggests possible Azure or AWS EU. Cannot confirm AWS-native.
pitch_note: Funded at $5M, 19 people, selling AI SaaS to enterprise marketing teams where procurement increasingly requires SOC 2. ISO 27001 in place shows security awareness — SOC 2 Type I is a logical next step for US enterprise deals. Score reduced for EU-heavy compliance posture and unknown AWS stack. Best angle: 'Your US enterprise pipeline will hit a SOC 2 gate — ISO 27001 gets you halfway there.'

name: Bolna AI

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 found on bolna.ai, docs, or public trust documentation. Compliance page covers India DPDP and phone number regulations only.
Sells to BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, Insurance) and enterprise clients including Varun Beverages, Spinny — regulated buyers requiring SOC 2 for US expansion.

hiring_signals: No open roles on YC platform at time of research
Company at 21 employees post-$6.3M seed — likely scaling infra team internally
aws_evidence: On-prem deployment docs reference AWS as supported deployment target alongside GCP, Azure, and bare metal. India + USA data residency options suggest multi-cloud.
pitch_note: Well-funded ($6.3M seed, General Catalyst led) voice AI platform selling into BFSI and enterprise — exactly the buyers that demand SOC 2. India-first but US expansion trajectory is clear. No SOC 2 found. Pitch angle: 'Your US BFSI customers will require SOC 2 Type II before signing — start with Type I now to unblock the pipeline while you build the controls.'

name: Hyperspell

soc2_evidence.signal: Homepage explicitly states 'SOC 2 Certified' — 'Independent audit confirming that we safeguard your data with the highest security standards.' Also GDPR compliant.

hiring_signals: Founding Platform Engineer (SF, $150K-$220K, 0.5-1.5% equity) — infrastructure-heavy role
aws_evidence: No cloud provider publicly stated. Integrates with 50+ enterprise tools but hosting stack not disclosed.
pitch_note: Already SOC 2 certified — disqualified as a new buyer. No fit for SOC 2 attestation services at this time.

name: Aspect

soc2_evidence.signal: Homepage prominently lists 'AICPA SOC 2' compliance alongside HIPAA and GDPR. Trust center at trust.aspect.inc. SSO/SAML, audit logging, multi-region replication in place.

hiring_signals: Founding Engineer (NYC, $120K-$175K, 1.5-2.5% equity) — general engineering, no infra/security specificity
aws_evidence: Supports 'existing on-prem and S3 storage' and offers BYOS3 (Bring Your Own S3) enterprise feature, indicating deep AWS S3 integration. Primary cloud unconfirmed but S3-native product architecture.
pitch_note: Already SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant — disqualified. Very small team (3 people) and already over-invested in compliance relative to stage. No fit.
